name: Paddle
tagline: Merchant-of-record payments, subscriptions, tax, checkout, and billing APIs.
shortDescription: Paddle provides unified APIs for checkout, products, prices, subscriptions, transactions, customers, and webhooks.
agentSummary: Agents can manage SaaS billing objects and checkout flows with tax/MoR handled by Paddle, subject to business review.
bestFor: SaaS billing, subscriptions, checkout, tax handling, and merchant-of-record workflows.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Live billing, tax, refunds, and customer communication need review. Live payments, refunds, payouts, tax, disputes, and business verification can move money or create compliance exposure; keep agents in sandbox or test mode until a human approves live changes. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Account setup or elevated access may require vendor, admin, or compliance approval before an agent can operate independently.
pricingSummary: Public transaction-based pricing for Paddle Billing.
authModel: API keys, client-side tokens, notification/webhook signatures.
accountCreation: Self-serve signup with business verification for live selling.
browserSupport: Dashboard is useful for review, verification, and billing operations.

capabilities.detail: Developer docs describe a unified API for payments, tax, subscriptions, checkout, and metrics.
Docs include API reference, webhooks, checkout, and billing guides.
Self-serve signup with business verification for live selling.
Dashboard is useful for review, verification, and billing operations.
Sandbox environment supports testing checkout and subscription workflows.
